About Us

Welcome to Sabari Tawa Fry Non Veg Restaurant — your destination for fresh, flavorful, and authentic non-veg dishes. We specialize in delicious tawa-fried chicken, mutton, fish, kebabs, biryani, and Chinese favorites, all prepared with quality ingredients and traditional spices. Every order is cooked fresh to deliver the best taste and quality. Whether you choose takeaway or home delivery, we're here to serve hot and tasty food with quick service and affordable prices.

Fresh Taste • Quality Ingredients • Fast Delivery

At Sabari Tawa Fry, we serve the authentic taste of your favorite non-veg dishes with love and freshness. Our menu includes Chicken Tawa Fry, Fish Fry, Mutton Fry, Chicken Lollipop, Fried Rice, Noodles, Biryani, and many more mouth-watering dishes. We focus on hygienic cooking, generous portions, and quick service. Visit us or order on WhatsApp for Takeaway and Home Delivery.

Taste that brings you back every time!
